about: The source model of an N5 container (spec/virtualize/n5.md, spec/virtualize.md §9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#9-n5-profile>): the elements a parser emits in a store IR (conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>), the tables of data types, compressions and units, and the roles a candidate's document and a dataset's document play, each with the constraints a container must meet to have the N5 convention's layout. The parser checks this schema as it reads each document; the projection reads a valid IR and checks nothing but the keys of its output.

data_types.about: dataType: the bytes per element b; the Zarr data_type is the same name

levels.about: a compression's levels from, to, and the level when the member is absent (Java's Deflater level -1 is 6)

units.about: conventions §5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#5-units>: a unit string and its name; a name is kept as it is

elements.about: The store IR of an N5 container: the listing (directories and objects, conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>), and the documents the profile reads, held whole. `<D>` is a candidate's directory (spec/virtualize/n5.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#2-nodes>); `<m>` a member name, named by the rule of spec/virtualize/nd2.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/nd2.md#53-elements> with `gaps` and `json` the fixed names (a name with an unpaired surrogate escape has U+FFFD in its place).

<D>/attributes.json.about: the document of a node (a group or a dataset), held: its bytes are in ir/held

children.<m>: ascii[n]: the bytes of the value of the top-level member <m>, as written (JSON text); a member given twice is two values, the later one named <m>~ with index 1, and so on
children.gaps/<o>: the rest: braces, names, colons, commas and whitespace (the whole document when it has no member)
children.json: ascii[s]: in place of the members and gaps, the whole document, when it has more than 4096 top-level members (json.rs MAX_MEMBERS, shared by the store formats)

<k>.about: every other object (blocks, other objects, the documents of datasets nested in a dataset): referenced, one leaf, or empty

candidate.about: the document of a candidate (spec/virtualize/n5.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#2-nodes>) that the profile reads, before it is read

constraints.message: {key}: invalid JSON: the document is empty

document.about: a candidate's document, read (spec/virtualize.md §1.6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize.md#16-json-documents> is the reader's)

dataset.about: a dataset's document (spec/virtualize/n5.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#3-datasets>): its members, `members` its member names, and the compression object `c` (its member `compression`, or {type: compressionType}) with `c_members` its member names

constraints.require: kind(dimensions) == 'list' && n >= 1 && n <= max_dimensions && int(dimensions, 0, max_safe)

constraints.message: {path}: compression is not an object with a string type
gzip useZlib {c.useZlib} is not a boolean
gzip level {c.level} is not an integer from -1 to 9
zstd level {c.level} is not an integer from -131072 to 22
blosc clevel {c.clevel} is not an integer from 0 to 9

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: the JSON reading of spec/virtualize.md §1.6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize.md#16-json-documents> (sjson.rs: UTF-8, no byte order mark, nesting, literals, numbers kept exactly), which candidates are read and in which rounds (a candidate inside a dataset is never read), and the members' extents. The projection computes the layout of spec/virtualize/n5.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#2-nodes>–§4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#4-multiscale-images> (nodes, arrays, codecs, the multiscale conventions COSEM and n5-viewer, which recognize or not and reject nothing but a scale that is not finite) and §6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/vzip/blob/main/spec/virtualize/n5.md#6-other-objects> (other objects, the keys of the output).
